title: 🐘 Urgent Security Update for PHP!
body: PHP released new security updates covering 17 vulnerabilities, including seven critical ones that could allow malicious software to run on servers.
The most dangerous is a flaw in the session system that lets an attacker run commands through session files, and another that allows smuggling hidden requests to the application server.
Simply put, if your website runs on PHP, update immediately to the latest version and restart the server.
Do you run a website on PHP? And did you update it today?
